what_it_does: This work tackles extreme-scale computational fluid dynamics simulations of spacecraft with multiple engines, where the simulation models over one quadrillion degrees of freedom (parameters describing fluid behavior). It uses Information Geometric Regularization—a mathematical technique that simplifies complex problems—combined with mixed precision computation (using both 16-bit and 32-bit floating-point numbers to save memory). The approach runs on heterogeneous platforms with both CPUs and GPUs to distribute the enormous computational load.
